statement: The CISA KEV catalog adds a Siemens Software Center vulnerability, the flaw ClickFix attackers reportedly exploited, with a date-added value between 2026-10-21 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog lists a Siemens Software Center CVE with dateAdded between 2026-10-21 and 2026-11-20 inclusive; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No Siemens Software Center CVE carries a KEV dateAdded value inside 2026-10-21 to 2026-11-20.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
